title: On Arresting the two men at the gate
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：arrest　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 arrest 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the builder ① arrested the two men at the gate in public, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② arrests the two men at the gate in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ arrest the two men at the gate at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ arrested the two men at the gate before — a line in the plan for October 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Arresting the two men at the gate in public, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ arrest the spread of the fire in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Arrest the spread of the fire at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ arrests the spread of the fire in public every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply  arrested the two men at the gate again when nobody else would.

To arrest the two men at the gate, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody arrests the two men at the gate in silence again and somebody must arrest the two men at the gate in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 逮捕（一般过去式 arrested the two men at the gate：1953 年施工员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 逮捕（一般现在 arrests the two men at the gate：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 逮捕（不定式 to arrest the two men at the gate：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 逮捕（过去完成时 had arrested the two men at the gate：1947 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 逮捕（动名词 arresting the two men at the gate 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 遏制（arrest the spread of the fire：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去遏制火势的蔓延）
G. v. 遏制（arrest the spread of the fire：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 逮捕（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 arrests the spread of the fire，而母亲又一次 arrested the two men at the gate）

items.q: arrested the two men at the gate
arrests the two men at the gate
to arrest the two men at the gate

arresting the two men at the gate

arrests the spread of the fire in public

answers.why: arrest 意为“逮捕”，1953 年施工员当着众人面逮捕在门口逮捕那两个人，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 arrested。
arrest 意为“逮捕”，自那以后施工员一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 arrests。
arrest 意为“逮捕”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯逮捕在门口逮捕那两个人”，此处为不定式 to arrest the two men at the gate。
arrest 意为“逮捕”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1960 年之前就有人逮捕过，故用过去完成时 had arrested。
arrest 意为“逮捕”，施工员说“逮捕在门口逮捕那两个人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 arresting the two men at the gate 作主语。
arrest 意为“遏制”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去遏制火势的蔓延”，should ever 之后用原形 arrest the spread of the fire。
arrest 意为“遏制”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻遏制火势的蔓延（arrest the spread of the fire at once），以后再也不要提起。
arrest 意为“逮捕”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例遏制火势的蔓延，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 arrests。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，施工员当着众人面逮捕在门口逮捕那两个人；工地里每一个帮工都说这是头一回。（arrested the two men at the gate）
多年以后，施工员仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（arrests the two men at the gate）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯逮捕在门口逮捕那两个人这件事本身。（to arrest the two men at the gate）
早在 1947 年就有人逮捕在门口逮捕那两个人，十月那天施工图上的一行字就是证据。（had arrested the two men at the gate）
施工员说过，当着众人面逮捕在门口逮捕那两个人这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（arresting the two men at the gate 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻遏制火势的蔓延，以后再也不要提起。（arrest the spread of the fire，祈使句）
answers: In 1953 the builder arrested the two men at the gate in public, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the builder still arrests the two men at the gate in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to arrest the two men at the gate at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had arrested the two men at the gate long before 1960, and the line in the plan for October proves it.
Arresting the two men at the gate in public, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Arrest the spread of the fire at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 arrest 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the builder arrested the two men at the gate in public, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder arrests the two men at the gate in silence whenever the site asks.
Arresting the two men at the gate in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever arrest the spread of the fire in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site arrests the spread of the fire in public every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother arrested the two men at the gate again, and the site remembered that half.
